summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Nathan David Gerbe, an American professional ice hockey player born July 24, 1987. It states that he currently plays for the Cleveland Monsters of the American Hockey League while under contract to the Columbus Blue Jackets of the National Hockey League. It also lists his earlier teams, Genève-Servette HC of the National League and the Carolina Hurricanes and Buffalo Sabres of the NHL, and notes that at 5 feet 4 inches he is the shortest player in the NHL.
one_line: American ice hockey forward Nathan Gerbe, a 5-foot-4 player under contract to the Columbus Blue Jackets, with prior NHL and Swiss league stints.
